title: Rates, Not Crypto: Reading This Week’s Bitcoin Move
description: Advisors hunting for a crypto specific catalyst behind this week’s Bitcoin move will not find one. The driver sits in the rates complex. The minutes of the last FOMC meeting showed a committee more divided, and more restrictive, than the decision it went on to publish, but every print since has cut the other way.
